title: Debugging
summary: Program debugging and tracing. Step through a program, trace what it does, and watch the network and the disk.
consent: These tools can read the memory of any process. They can read every packet on the box. Install them only while you need them. The box removes them after the time that you select.
notes: perf is built for the Debian kernel. On a vendor kernel, parts of perf can fail.

bpftrace, bcc (bpfcc-tools) and bpftool install only on 64-bit boards. A 32-bit ARM kernel cannot load their programs. On a 64-bit board, they need the BTF of the kernel (/sys/kernel/btf/vmlinux) or its headers.
systemd-coredump collects core dumps while the toolkit is installed. This is an exception to the rule that toolkit services stay stopped. The other services of the toolkit stay stopped.
